name: Madrigalejo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of black, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Madrigalejo (a crozier on black and a castle above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Madrigalejo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Madrigalejo arms — crozier and castle above waves
